next.reason: 2023 has no debugging lines. Its fixed indicators (§2023:6.2.2) are comment, continuation and the space 'source indicator' only; there is no 'D' indicator, and §2023:6.5 GR5 copies only a line that 'contains a source indicator'. No 2023 rule lets 'D' lines appear in library text or pseudo-text, or has their words match 'as if the D did not appear'.
